findings.desc: CHK-002:happy verificationEvidence (via lattice checklist_get/evidence_inspect) claims `lattice autopilot_review_submit x3` recorded three local single-host verdicts, but `lattice autopilot_review_status --storyId=B-503b --runId=default-run --format=json` and r1/r2/r3 all report totalVerdicts=0 and localReviewEvidenceRefs=[]; the happy intent requires three local single-host audit rounds recorded as Non-authority evidence, so the evidence coverage for that requirement is missing. severity: high
findings.resolvedReason: Replaced the ambiguous CHK-002 evidence command "lattice autopilot_review_submit x3" with exact runId-specific autopilot_review_status checks for B-503b-local-audit-r1/r2/r3. Each status shows totalVerdicts=1, passingIndependentHosts=1, staleVerdicts=0, and the expected localReviewEvidenceRefs; default-run is no longer used as proof.
